The interpreter floor is checked BEFORE the imports it protects, because typing.Required needs 3.11 and this script runs under whatever python3 a bare machine has. An ImportError from inside the import block names a symbol rather than the reason, and byte-compiling would not catch it because compilation does not resolve imports. E402 requires imports first; a bootstrap cannot.

The facts it reads are collected and validated against sheet-facts/v1 by the tooling before they are written.
